---
id: env.def.pollutant
type: definition
heading: Pollutant
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Any solid, liquid, gaseous, biological, radiological or thermal irritant or contaminant, including smoke, vapour, soot, fumes, acids, alkalis, chemicals, fuel, hydrocarbons, sewage, waste, and electromagnetic fields. Waste includes material to be recycled, reconditioned or reclaimed. Pollutant does not include asbestos, mould or per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances, which are dealt with by the exclusions.
